meta.title: easy-extrude gestures
meta.description: Reusable gestures of the easy-extrude editor. Scenarios compose these instead of re-deriving menu paths, so a UI change is fixed here once.

ee/new-blank-project.description: Start ▾ dialog → 空のプロジェクト (the boot dialog opens on its own at first launch).

ee/add.description: Shift+A over the viewport, then pick an Add-menu entry.

ee/sketch-rect.description: Draw a sketch rectangle on the ground plane between two world points (mm).

ee/extrude.description: Enter extrude phase, raise the height by dragging upward `rise` px, confirm.

ee/orbit.description: Right-drag orbit from empty ground (lower right) (cursor hidden — it is a camera move, not a gesture).
